title: New Year's Pomegranate Champagne Cocktail
description: A ruby pomegranate sparkling wine cocktail for a New Year toast.
author: Better Sweet Drinks
ingredients: 4 oz chilled dry Champagne or other sparkling wine
instructions:
1. Add pomegranate and lemon juices to a chilled flute; sweeten to taste.
  2. Slowly top with sparkling wine, pausing for the foam to settle.
  3. Stir gently once and garnish with lemon or pomegranate.
notes: Prepare one serving at a time. Add sparkling ingredients only when ready to serve.
